composition_label: Deep research -> Document review -> Behavioral personalization -> Product comparison

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory; no other builds or repository files accessed.

shared_schema.input: Exact fields: schema_version, synthetic=true, as_of UTC timestamp, documents, requirements, products, events, preferences. IDs must be unique within their collections and references must exist.
shared_schema.documents: id, title, published_at, claims. Each claim: product_id, requirement_id, stance (supports/opposes/uncertain), quote. One claim per product/requirement per document.
shared_schema.requirements: id, description, mandatory boolean. At least one requirement.
shared_schema.products: id, name, category, attributes: price, weight, runtime; each null or {value, unit}. At least one product.
shared_schema.events: id, product_id, type (browse/purchase), at. Duplicate IDs and future dates rejected. One user's caller-supplied activity only.
shared_schema.preferences: half_life_days > 0, unique preferred_categories, nonnegative weights for price/weight/runtime/behavior with positive sum, nullable max_price_usd.
shared_schema.stage_envelope: schema_version, stage, records, warnings. Each record carries product_id. Shared validation reconstructs expected deterministic artifacts to verify schema, evidence provenance, numerical results, eligibility, and gap preservation at every handoff.
shared_schema.output: schema_version, synthetic=true, status=ok, as_of, stages with research/review/behavior/compare artifacts; errors have schema_version, status=error, error and exit code 2.
shared_schema.numbers: Finite nonnegative values only; booleans are not numbers. Physical measurements and budgets capped at 1e12, weights at 1e6, half-life between 0.001 and 1e6 days.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Per-product requirement findings: state, every matching document/claim-index citation, quote, stance, unresolved question. Review adds mandatory flags, gaps, eligibility.
Validated eligibility gates personalization; full checks and gap IDs persist. Ineligible products remain explicit excluded records with zero activity score.
Validated eligible IDs and normalized behavioral scores drive comparison; review checks, gaps and behavior mode persist in every ranked record. Budget exclusions remain explicit warnings.

behavior.research: Synthesize all supplied documents per product/requirement. Support plus opposition is disputed; otherwise any uncertain claim is unresolved; support-only is supported; opposition-only contradicted; absence missing. Every non-supported finding has an unresolved evidence question. Conflicts are never silently resolved by majority.
behavior.review: Only supported mandatory requirements pass the evidence gate. Optional gaps remain visible but do not block. No certification or compliance claim.
behavior.personalization: Signal sums event_weight * 2^(-age_days/half_life_days), with browse=1 and purchase=3. Divide by largest eligible product signal. If no positive eligible history remains (including underflow), category preference yields 1 or 0; no preferred category gives neutral zero scores.
behavior.comparison: Normalize USD, g/kg and h/min. Apply nullable hard USD budget; missing price fails a set budget. Min-max utilities favor cheaper, lighter, longer-runtime products; missing values score 0, equal known values 1. Weighted mean combines attributes and behavior. Exact ties sort by product ID. Records with canonical attributes form the side-by-side comparison.
behavior.determinism: Fixed caller-provided as_of; no clock, random source, network, or model. Research and review order by product ID; citations by document ID; comparison by descending unrounded score then product ID.
behavior.error_handling: Strict JSON keys and references; duplicate JSON object keys and non-finite constants rejected; malformed/file/encoding/validation errors print one JSON object with status error and exit 2.

coverage: CLI success, usage, file and encoding errors
